Indian Mathematics Record
Treatise: Aryabhatiya (Ganitapada, Verses 32-33)
Author: Aryabhata I
Period: 499 CE (Classical Period, Kusumapura / Pataliputra)
Domain: algebra

HISTORICAL_FORMULA:
Kuttaka (The Pulverizer algorithm): Recursive division method for solving indeterminate linear equations in integers

MODERN_EQUIVALENT:
ax - by = c where a, b, c in Z; solved via Extended Euclidean Algorithm computing Bézout coefficients x_0, y_0

Mathematical Context: Developed to solve astronomical conjunction problems determining the elapsed time (ahargana) from mean planetary positions.
Historical Significance: First systematic algorithmic treatment of linear Diophantine equations in mathematical history.
Provenance Reference: The Aryabhatiya of Aryabhata (Translated by Walter Eugene Clark, University of Chicago Press, 1930)
